title: LambdaFunctionConfiguration

LambdaFunctionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Lambda function that Amazon S3 invokes when the specified event type occurs.

Events.description: The Amazon S3 bucket event for which to invoke the Lambda function. For more information, see Supported Event Types in the Amazon S3 User Guide.

description: A container for specifying the configuration for Lambda notifications.
